signals.evidence_quote: walls of brown water poured through Nairobi’s most densely packed neighbourhoods – Mukuru, Kibra, Mathare, Huruma, South B and C, Pipeline, Githurai, Kahawa West – sweeping cars off roads, tearing through informal settlements, and dragging people into drainage channels that double as open sewers.
